name: playwright_bdd
description: A Playwright BDD framework using Cucumber and TypeScript

scripts.test:completeSuite:firefox: cross-env REPORT_SUITE="Complete Suite" BROWSER=Firefox npm run playwright -- src/features/*.feature
scripts.test:completeSuite:webkit: cross-env REPORT_SUITE="Complete Suite" BROWSER=Webkit npm run playwright -- src/features/*.feature
scripts.test:completeSuite:msedge: cross-env REPORT_SUITE="Complete Suite" BROWSER=MSedge npm run playwright -- src/features/*.feature
scripts.test:completeSuite:runAllBrowsersSimulta: concurrently "npm run test:completeSuite:chromium" "npm run test:completeSuite:firefox" "npm run test:completeSuite:webkit" "npm run test:completeSuite:msedge"
